verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਲੇ ਜਾਤ ਸੁਖ ਗਹੇ ਕਰ ਦੁਚਿਤੁ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਭਟਕਾ ਸੋ ਭੇਟ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dheep jot liv laagai chale jaat sukh gahe kar dhuchit haivai bhaTakaa so bheT hai ||

en.bdb: Just as focusing the mind in the light of a lamp helps walk steadily, but once the lamp is held in hand, one becomes unsure to step forward because the shadow of the hand caused by the lamp light impairs the vision.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਧਿ ਕੂਲ ਬੈਠਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਚੁਨਤ ਹੰਸ ਪੈਰਤ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰ ਲਹਰ ਲਪੇਟ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dhadh kool baiTh mukataa chunat ha(n)s pairat na paavai paar lahar lapeT hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a swan picks pearls on the bank of lake Mansarover, but when swimming in the water, can find no pearl nor can go across. He may get caught in the waves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਭਾਵ ਸਿਧ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਿਕਟ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਸਾ ਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise nirakh agan kai madh bhaav sidh hot nikaT bikaT dhukh sahasaa na meT hai ||

en.bdb: Just as keeping fire in the middle is more helpful to all for warding off cold, but if placed too near creates fear of burning. Thus the discomfort of cold is supplemented by the fear of burning.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਮੀਪ ਸਿੰਘ ਸਾਪ ਕੀ ਅਖੇਟ ਹੈ ॥੫੬੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur sabadh saneh kai param padh moorat sameep si(n)gh saap kee akheT hai ||565||

en.bdb: Similarly loving the advice and teachings of Guru and lodging it in the consciousness, one reaches supreme state. But to focus on any form of the Guru and then expecting/longing for nearness of the Lord is like falling a prey to snake or lion. (It is a spiritual death).  (565)
